rdfs:label: last
rdfs:comment: The final page in a paged ActivityStreams Collection's ordering — the end of the first→next chain. In reverse-chronological ActivityPub collections this is the page with the oldest items.
notes: Optional companion to `as:first`. Useful when the Collection has stable bounds (an outbox with finite history, an archived event log) so clients can deep-link to the end without walking the whole chain. Servers may omit it for unbounded or live-growing Collections.

examples.title: Paginated outbox with first and last
